checks.description: Every quoted fact, number, and date comes only from VERIFIED fields in the chip (or the cartridge.json it cites). No invented credits, dates, placements, or statistics. Audiartist entries are described as campaigns, never as placements.

No growth language ('and climbing'), no unverified statistics (e.g. the Doves & Diamonds 132K claim), no invented quotes, bios, press coverage, or lyrics claims. The display string is exactly '307K plays'.
Every fact carries a copy-pasteable citation URL. Every number carries an observed date and a confidence label from the scale {VERIFIED, CLAIM-UNVERIFIED, ESTIMATE}.

Claims that failed verification (Flow / No Label Needed, DJ 6Rings / It's Goin, WATCH THA GAP) remain in the anomaly feed labeled CLAIM-UNVERIFIED with FAILED VERIFICATION / UNCONFIRMED status, never repeated as wins.
